entries.text: Mr. John gillnitz, death from massive blood loss... Due to what I can only describe as a skillful removal of his left lung.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It's Betts.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Doing what?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Guaranteed, Scully. This man's medical records will show he had lung cancer. And Leonard Betts was in need of what he had.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: How would he have known that?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: His Partner told me he had an exceptional ability to diagnose cancer. Maybe his need provided a heightened sense.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, whatever he was doing, he's taking the secret to his grave.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah, for the second time.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, Leonard Betts is dead. Of that I am absolutely certain, and he is not coming back.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You would have said the same thing about albert Tanner.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I don't understand.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Six years ago albert Tanner dies in a car accident. His mother buries him. Several days ago, the same man shows up as Leonard Betts. Explain that to me.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Obviously, someone's lying. Maybe the first death was staged.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You want to bet on that? Ugh. Will the real Leonard Betts please stand up?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, these men may be no more than monozygotic twins.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I don't think so, Scully. I think what we're standing witness to here... Goes way beyond the regeneration of a thumb or a limb, or even a new head.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, I don't know what you're getting at here. Regeneration of an entire body? I don't know why I'm listening.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Because I think that the fiery crash that killed this man was a decoy... And that this man lying here is still at large.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I'm scared, honey. The FBI-- they seem to know all about you. They dug up the coffin. They found your friend. I don't think they're ever going to leave you alone. And you're weak. You have to restore your strength. You know what you have to do. I'm your mother. And it's a mother's duty to provide.
entries.speaker: Elaine Tanner

entries.text: [ moans ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: If this man really exists, what makes you think he'd come back here?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The only person connected with Betts who knows his secret is his mom. If we're gonna get him, it'll be through her.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ siren wailing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ siren continues ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Get out of the truck!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Federal agents!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Get out of the truck!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Whoa! Whoa! What the hell?
entries.speaker: Paramedic 1

entries.text: What are you doing here?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We got a call. Elderly woman with massive chest trauma and blood loss. 3108 old bank.
entries.speaker: Paramedic 2

entries.text: Believe me, that's all we know!
entries.speaker: Paramedic 1

entries.text: Stay here. Mulder, get the e.m.t.s up here!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Guys, get in here!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: She has an open wound. A surgical cut.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Three guesses what was removed. He did this to her, and then he called an ambulance.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Judging by the response time, he might still be here.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Betts is gone. He must have taken off on foot.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, she's gonna be okay, Mulder. She's not out of the woods, but I think we might be able to get where he went out of her.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You stay with her. I'll call local p.d. And have them cordon off the area.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Okay.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: This is special agent Mulder with the FBI I've got an emergency situation in progress. I need all available units to 3108 old bank road. I'm searching for a murder suspect.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ radio Dispatch chatter ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder, it's me. We've got mrs. Tanner going into the e.r., but she took a downturn en route. They defibrillated her to try and get her heart back, but there's no chance of getting anything cogent from her. Not tonight, anyway. What about on your end?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We're going house to house here. That's the only thing I can think to do. We've got a chopper coming in, but I'd say Betts has a pretty good chance of getting away. If he steals a car or gets a ride, he could get away for good. I mean he obviously worked this thing out pretty well, Scully, so if there's anything you can get out of mrs. Tanner tonight, anything at all, at this point we don't have much else to go on.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, get over here right now.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Get over here right now. Oh!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm sorry. But you've got something I need.

entries.text: Oh, my god.

entries.text: Let's get a crash cart.

entries.text: They pronounced Betts ten minutes ago.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: He's dead?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: As near as anyone can tell. His mom's alive though, mainly due to the fact that Betts dressed her wounds so carefully. She's gonna pull through, at least for the present.

entries.text: Cancer.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah. Uh... "metastatic rabdomyo sarcoma," to be precise. She was treated for it previously. Got a clean bill of health about three months ago. You did a good job, Scully. You should be proud.

entries.text: I want to go home.
